message.content: 截至目前（2026 年），全球票房最高的電影是《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》（Avengers: Endgame，2019）。它在全球範圍內累計票房約 27.98 億美元，超越了 2009 年的《阿凡達》（Avatar）——後者在 2021 年重映後的總票房約 28.47 億美元，但《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》在原始上映期間就已經成為歷史上票房最高的影片。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" (What is the highest-grossing movie of all time?). They want the answer. We can provide the answer: "Avengers: Endgame" (2019) is the highest worldwide grossing film, surpassing "Avatar" (2009). However, note that "Avatar" had higher worldwide gross before being surpassed by "Avengers: Endgame". Also, "Avengers: Endgame" had $2.798 billion worldwide. But "Avatar" had $2.847 billion after re-release. But the question likely expects "Avengers: Endgame" as the highest. We can mention both. No need to call the function. The function is for searching movies. Not needed. So just answer.
